patterns.title: Interface in practice
patterns.intro: Use these live examples to build recognizable, readable interfaces. Each example uses our shared website components.
patterns.cardsRule: Give each card one purpose: a short heading, supporting information and an action when needed. Align padding across a row; allow text to wrap. Keep important information visible.
patterns.defaultCopy: Use the default card for settings summaries, explanatory content and grouped information. A plain card does not imply a click.
patterns.interactiveCopy: Use the interactive treatment for a destination or next step. Provide a real link or button, a clear label and keyboard focus. Do not nest buttons inside a whole-card link.
patterns.featureCopy: Use FeatureCard for a product capability: one icon, a short title and a concise explanation. Keep the icon decorative when the title supplies its meaning.
patterns.gradientCopy: Use a subtle gradient for an introduction or callout. Keep ordinary content on neutral surfaces and reserve strong color for meaningful emphasis.
patterns.actionsCopy: Use one primary action per decision. Outline buttons support it; text links handle navigation. A pending action keeps its label, communicates progress and prevents repeat submission.
patterns.statusCopy: Use short, descriptive labels. State connection status or hop count explicitly; color does not certify trust. Badge examples here use neutral styling.
patterns.formsCopy: Keep labels visible above fields. Explain the expected input and place a specific error next to the field. Link help and errors for screen readers. These examples are read-only.
patterns.fieldHint: Example: a short name you can recognize.
patterns.layoutCopy: Use a consistent rhythm within each component family. Stack columns on narrow screens and let translated text expand.
patterns.paddingValue: 16 px compact · 24 px standard · 32 px feature or spacious.
patterns.gridValue: 24 px between cards; 32 px between larger content groups.
patterns.radiusValue: 8 px controls · 12 px standard cards · 16 px feature cards.
patterns.widthValue: 1152 px maximum for marketing sections, with 24 px horizontal gutters.
patterns.focusCopy: Keep focus visible on every action. Test light and dark surfaces, keyboard navigation, hover and disabled states. Do not use hover alone to reveal an essential action.
patterns.disclosureCopy: Use disclosures for optional detail, with a clear question or label. Keep essential instructions outside the collapsed area. This example uses the shared AccordionList.
patterns.emptyCopy: Explain what is missing and offer a relevant next step. While loading, preserve context and announce progress. On error, keep user input and offer a specific recovery action.
